Description: Exam Question Correct Answers Exposed to Students in API Responses
Impact: Total loss of exam integrity; students can view all correct answers in browser DevTools during the exam.
Evidence: Questions = e.ExamQuestionBanks.Select(eq => new QuestionBankReadDto { CorrectAnswer = eq.Question.CorrectAnswer, ... })
Recommended Remediation: Separate QuestionBankReadDto into QuestionStudentDto (without CorrectAnswer) and QuestionTeacherDto (with CorrectAnswer). Strip CorrectAnswer in student-facing endpoints.

Description: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) and Missing Authentication on Profile Endpoints
Impact: Unauthenticated attacker can read or alter personal details of any student, teacher, or administrator in the school.
Evidence: [HttpGet("profile/{id}")] and [HttpPut("profile/{id}")] lack [Authorize] attribute; account ID accepted directly from route without user claim verification.
Recommended Remediation: Add [Authorize] attribute to both profile endpoints. Enforce that requester ID matches route ID or requester holds Superadmin/Admin role.

Description: Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation / Arbitrary Role Registration
Impact: Any external user can create an account with administrative permissions (mapped to Board role).
Evidence: if (roleName.Equals("Admin") || roleName.Equals("Superadmin")) { roleName = "Board"; } var role = await _db.Roles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(...);
Recommended Remediation: Restructure registration: public registration should only allow Student role. Teacher and Admin/Board account creation must be restricted to Superadmin.

Description: Insecure Credential Storage with Plaintext Password Fallback and Unsalted SHA-256
Impact: Compromised database allows immediate plaintext password access and weak hash cracking; password hashes leaked in application logs.
Evidence: if (string.Equals(inputClean, storedClean, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { isValidPassword = true; } _logger.LogWarning("... Stored: {StoredHash}", storedHash);
Recommended Remediation: Remove plaintext and raw SHA-256 fallbacks. Migrate all legacy accounts to BCrypt (cost >= 11) or ASP.NET Core PasswordHasher. Stop logging password hashes.

Description: Hardcoded Secrets, Encryption Keys, and Database Credentials Committed to Repository
Impact: Attacker with repository access can forge JWT authentication tokens and access database directly.
Recommended Remediation: Remove all credentials and JWT keys from git. Use environment variables, .NET User Secrets, or Azure Key Vault. Invalidate exposed JWT secret and change DB credentials.

Description: Missing Authorization and Identity Spoofing on Exam Submissions and CRUD Operations
Impact: Unauthenticated users can create, modify, delete exams and question banks, or submit answers on behalf of any student.
Evidence: [Route("api/[controller]")] [ApiController] without [Authorize]; submit checks: else if (dto.AccountId > 0) accountId = dto.AccountId;
Recommended Remediation: Decorate controllers and actions with [Authorize] and role policies. Extract user ID exclusively from ClaimsPrincipal (User.FindFirst), never trusting DTO-supplied account IDs.

Description: Broken Access Control on Student and Teacher Dashboards (Authorization Checks Commented Out)
Impact: Any authenticated student can inspect any other student's or teacher's performance analytics and exam records.
Evidence: if (!isAdmin && !isSelf) { // return Forbid(); // Commenting out for easier testing in dev... }
Recommended Remediation: Uncomment and strictly enforce role checks. Only Superadmin/Admin can view arbitrary accounts; teachers can only view their students; students can only view self.

Description: Denormalized Comma-Separated Multi-Class Storage in Relational Database
Impact: Violates 1NF; impossible to enforce foreign keys; forces slow in-memory filtering and split logic.
Recommended Remediation: Create a proper junction table Exam_Class (ExamId FK, ClassId FK) with composite PK and foreign keys to Exam_Details and Tbl_Class.

Description: Unmapped EF Core Navigation Properties and Missing Foreign Key Constraints
Impact: Developers must write manual query loops to stitch relational data, causing bugs and query overhead.
Evidence: [NotMapped] public virtual ICollection<ExamQuestionBank> ExamQuestionBanks { get; set; }; [NotMapped] public virtual QuestionBank Question { get; set; }
Recommended Remediation: Configure formal relationships in ElsewedySchoolSysDbDevContext using modelBuilder (HasMany/WithOne with HasForeignKey).

Description: Lack of Exam Attempt Model and Destructive One-Shot Submission Semantics
Impact: Students cannot save drafts; network failure or accidental refresh results in total answer loss; zero attempt metadata.
Evidence: var existingAnswers = await _context.StudentExamAnswers.Where(...).ToListAsync(); if (existingAnswers.Any()) return BadRequest(...);
Recommended Remediation: Introduce ExamAttempt entity (Id, ExamId, AccountId, StartedAt, SubmittedAt, TimeSpentSeconds, Status). Decouple draft answers from finalized submissions.

Description: Whole-Table In-Memory Aggregation and Scalability Bottlenecks
Impact: Server memory exhaustion and high latency as database grows to thousands of questions and exams.
Evidence: var allLinks = await _context.ExamQuestionBanks.ToListAsync(); var allQuestions = await _context.QuestionBanks.ToDictionaryAsync(q => q.QuestionId);
Recommended Remediation: Rewrite repository queries using EF Core projections (.Select) and SQL joins (.Include) with server-side pagination (Skip/Take).

Description: Absence of Service Layer (Fat Controllers and Monolithic Repository Anti-pattern)
Impact: High maintenance costs; duplicated business logic; difficult to write unit tests; UI tied to database entities.
Evidence: Controllers execute grading logic directly inside action methods; repositories contain business rules and formatting methods.
Recommended Remediation: Refactor architecture to include clean Service Layer (e.g. IExamService, IGradingService, IAuthService). Split frontend mega-components into modular subviews.

Description: Zero Automated Test Coverage Across Entire Codebase
Impact: High regression risk; changes to grading, authentication, or exam logic cannot be verified automatically.
Evidence: Zero test projects (.csproj) in solution; package.json has no test runner configured.
Recommended Remediation: Implement backend unit and integration test suite using xUnit, Moq, and WebApplicationFactory. Implement frontend unit tests using Vitest and React Testing Library.

Description: Client-Side Only Exam Timing and Vulnerability to Clock Manipulation and Refresh
Impact: Students can manipulate local OS clock to extend exam deadlines; refreshing page discards all answers.
Evidence: const now = new Date(); const timeRemainingMs = endDate.getTime() - now.getTime(); setTimeRemaining(Math.max(0, Math.floor(timeRemainingMs / 1000)));
Recommended Remediation: Enforce server-side attempt timers. On exam start, persist StartTime on server. Validate remaining time on server submission. Implement autosave drafts.

Description: Legacy Schema Entanglement and Migration Drift
Impact: Repository cannot set up database from scratch via migrations; developers must restore 21MB SQL backup.
Evidence: InitialCreate drops pre-existing tables (Exam_Class) instead of creating schema. Contains 40+ unused legacy school tables.
Recommended Remediation: Extract clean, isolated Exam-Hub schema or create baseline idempotent SQL migration script for new environment provisioning.
